about: Sign-offs for the release gate (edakit gate). Each one counts only for the hash of its scope: 'circuit' = state_sha256 (graph, parts database, simulation config), 'electrical' = electrical_sha256 (the same without the footprint data of the parts entries – M-6), 'layout' = layout_sha256 (board files with their artwork, footprint geometry), 'fab' = fab_sha256 (what the manufacturer builds from: Gerber layers rasterised, drill hits, BOM and CPL rows – in the protocol header of a gate run with stage F). When something there changes, it no longer counts – copy the new hash from the protocol header after the check was repeated. phase: 'export' blocks the release, 'order' and 'acceptance' come after the export. An accepted warning with scope 'decision' counts regardless of the hash and refers to a numbered decision in the docs. Parts are signed in their parts entry (field 'verified').

manual.text: Critical parts (the coin cell holder, the LED, the button) checked a second time against the datasheet, independently – e.g. by the agent electrical-reviewer in its own session
manual.note: OK, 7 notes worked in (D-4, D-5); requirements met: R-1, R-2, R-4, R-5

manual.text: Regulatory review: circuit and parts against EU law for the purpose in the graph (RoHS, REACH, batteries, product safety) – e.g. by the agent regulatory-reviewer in its own session. No finding 'block' open. Support, not legal advice: no claim to correctness, nothing legally guaranteed
manual.note: OK for purpose private, 7 notes, none block or important (D-4). Support, not legal advice: no claim to correctness, nothing legally guaranteed

manual.text: Layout reviewed independently (manufacturability, mechanics, operation, looks) on the manufacturing files of a gate run with this layout – e.g. by the agent pcb-reviewer. No finding 'block' open, every 'important' finding fixed or rejected by the owner
At JLCPCB after the upload: assembly preview – rotation and polarity of every polarised part (compare with polarity_<board>.png); BOM without missing parts; price
Acceptance test of every delivered board: visual check, cell inserted, LED off at rest, LED lights while the button is pressed
